name: SlickDeals
desc:
Deal Hunter | $18-$20/hr | Data Entry/Research, No Sales Expectations
Company: Slickdeals (contract role staffed through TCW, with a path to convert to direct Slickdeals employment)
Industry: E-commerce / Deal Curation & Content
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Think of Slickdeals as a giant online community where people swap the best deals they find, and your job is to be one of the people feeding that community great finds. You'd dig through partner spreadsheets and your own research to spot genuinely good deals in categories like electronics, health and beauty, groceries, home goods, or apparel, post them, and then track how well those deals actually perform using data. You're not just posting things randomly. You're using performance history and insights to decide what's actually worth sharing, and you'll work with other teams like Business Development to keep that pipeline moving. This is a fast paced role built around a genuine love of finding a good deal, paired with enough comfort in Excel to actually analyze what's working.
assessment: Yes. Final candidates may be asked to complete a paid test video before being selected as an ongoing creator.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
Required Experience: Relevant experience, professional or personal, that makes the participant a genuine shopping expert in one or more categories. Basic Excel spreadsheet knowledge required.
Preferred Experience: Not separately broken out beyond the above.
Required Skills:
Technically savvy, able to quickly learn Slickdeals' internal systems
Strong, high-quality written content skills
Excellent oral and written communication
Basic Excel spreadsheet skills
Quick learner with close attention to detail
Genuine interest in data analytics
Comfortable in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work a permanent non-standard schedule that includes evenings and weekends
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A true deal hunter or coupon enthusiast who already spends time finding and sharing good deals personally
Someone comfortable with basic Excel work and interested in using data to make decisions
Someone who writes clearly and enjoys creating content people actually want to read
Someone who can commit long term to a non-traditional schedule involving weekends and evenings
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who needs a standard Monday through Friday, 9 to 5 schedule, since this role is built around weekend and evening coverage permanently
Anyone without at least basic comfort in Excel, since spreadsheet work is a real, daily part of the job
Anyone looking for guaranteed full-time direct employment right away, since this starts as a TCW contract role with conversion as a possibility, not a guarantee
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Deal curation
Excel data analysis
Content writing
Consumer trends expertise
Cross-functional collaboration
Data-driven decision making
E-commerce
Attention to detail
Performance tracking
Contract-to-hire
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Application → Assessment → Phone screen → Final interview. Total time to hire averages 3 to 15 days.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience finding and sharing great deals, personally or professionally.
Walk us through how comfortable you are with Excel and analyzing performance data.
What categories (electronics, health and beauty, home, apparel, groceries) do you know best as a shopper?
How do you feel about a permanent schedule that includes weekend and evening hours?
Describe a time you had to write clear, engaging content quickly under a deadline.
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $18 to $20/hr, with exact pay discussed and tailored during the interview process.
Shift: Training runs Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM CST. After training, choose from two ongoing shift options, both Friday through Tuesday with Wednesday and Thursday off: 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM CST, or 12:30 PM to 9:00 PM CST. This is a permanent non-standard schedule, not a temporary training arrangement.
Benefits: Not stated in posting. This starts as a contract role through TCW, so benefits would likely follow TCW's contractor terms until or unless the role converts to direct Slickdeals employment. Confirm directly.
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen.
Felony Friendly?: Yes. The posting states Slickdeals will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with Ban the Box legislation.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting.
Notes: This is a genuinely good fit for a participant who already loves finding deals and has some comfort with spreadsheets, since that specific combination is the real qualifier here, not a formal degree or years of experience. The weekend and evening schedule is permanent, not just during a training ramp-up, so set that expectation clearly upfront. This is a contract role through TCW with a real possibility of converting to direct Slickdeals employment, worth explaining to a participant so they understand it's not guaranteed permanent from day one. The company also participates in E-Verify, so work authorization needs to be squared away before applying.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in the posting. A reasonable inferred path based on the role would be Deal Hunter → Senior Deal Hunter or Content Curator → Content Strategist → Editorial or Content Manager, but this isn't confirmed by Slickdeals directly, so flag it as an estimate if it comes up with a participant.
